allowedSourceMaterial.overview: When Ah Bu, a girl from a small fishing town in Taiwan, finds a glass bottle with a romantic message, she travels to Hong Kong to find her prince charming. As it turns out, her prince charming, Albert, happens to be gay. But all is not lost when Ah Bu meets the dashing Chi Wu. Meanwhile, Ah Bu's boyfriend from Taiwan comes looking for her, as the action and romance follow Ah Bu back to Taiwan.

facts.title: Gorgeous

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: When Ah Bu's quest for an ideal romance takes an immediate detour in Hong Kong, can a sudden connection with the dashing Chi Wu withstand the chaotic arrival of her past?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: Inspired by a romantic message found in a bottle, Taiwanese villager Ah Bu travels to Hong Kong in search of true love, only to encounter unexpected twists, a charming new spark, and pursuit from back home.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Light, funny, and lively action-romance that keeps a steady pace, making for a fun, engaging night with friends or a partner.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Vincent Kok Tak-Chiu blends energetic martial arts action and lighthearted romantic comedy, offering a fun adventure packed with playful complications and cross-border chase.
